children: AAON announced it will operate under the trade name The Aaon Group and updated its investor presentation highlighting a $2.0B backlog and 2026 guidance.
Corporate identity: AAON will operate under the trade name The Aaon Group to reflect a multi-brand enterprise with AAON and BASX.
Investor materials: Updated investor presentation furnished as Exhibit 99.2 and press release as Exhibit 99.1 to the 8-K.
Backlog & scale: Presentation cites a $2.0B order backlog and significant BASX backlog growth supporting capacity expansion.
2026 outlook: Company projects 55%–60% sales growth, gross margin of 25%–26%, SG&A 13%–14%, and D&A of $95–$100M.
Operations & strategy: Emphasis on two-brand structure, manufacturing expansion (1M+ sq ft added since 2024), product innovation, and focus on data center market.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: AAON to Operate as The Aaon Group; investor presentation updates show $2.0B backlog, 55–60% 2026 sales growth outlook
